purpose_context: Vikunja's project structure drifted into pseudo-view projects (Today, Someday, etc.) that conflate cross-project views with topic buckets. This mission additively creates the canonical topic projects — Felix / kg-automation, a Clients folder with PointerHealth and spec-kitty sub-projects, and a Personal catch-all — verifies Inbox is present, and deletes the legacy ad-hoc saved filters, so Kent's task system reflects domain ownership rather than temporal context. Task migration and deletion of task-bearing projects are handled separately in issue #717.
purpose_tldr: Establish Vikunja's canonical topic-project structure and remove legacy saved filters.
